subject: Request: Bespoke Integration + Premium Support credit for MediSync POC
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Eva Sanchez <eva.sanchez@medisync.com>, Ryan Hart <ryan.hart@medisync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Bespoke integration + premium support for POC — proposed credit

Hi Eva / Ryan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was excited about the latency and audit logging features. As discussed, MediSync wants Redwood to build a small custom connector to their on-prem EMR as part of the 90-day POC. That work is outside the standard onboarding scope and we estimate ~120 hours of engineering + 40 hours of PS for QA and runbooks (SOW attached).

To accelerate the POC and reduce the friction for procurement, I can bundle:
- Redwood Hosted inference (standard usage pricing)
- Premium Support (24/7 coverage, 15-minute paging) for the POC period
- One-off custom connector build (integration scope doc attached)

Requested commercial concession: a one-time professional services credit of $35,000 applied to the first invoice to cover ~50% of integration effort, and inclusion of Premium Support at a reduced flat fee of $4,000/mo for the POC period. This lets MediSync run a high-fidelity pilot while we prove value.

Can you confirm signoff from your procurement/legal side on receiving a combined proposal (SOW + MSA redlines)? If so I will route to Finance/Deal Desk to finalize.

Thanks — I’ve attached the draft SOW and pricing sheet for your review.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MediSync_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW, draft), Pricing_breakdown_MediSync.xlsx (line-item pricing)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Bespoke integration + premium support for POC — commercial details and ask

Lukas — thanks for the quick summary and attachments. Reviewing numbers: the $35k credit covers roughly half our estimated PS burn, which is reasonable for a high-potential POC, but we need Exec signoff for the credit plus the non-standard low Premium Support fee.

Questions for Deal Desk/Finance before we escalate:
- Confirm total PS estimate (hours x rate) and margin impact (please add to Pricing_breakdown).
- Is the integration scope likely to require >160 hours if unexpected edge cases (HL7 adapters, network MTU issues) arise? If yes we should include an overage rate and an approval trigger.
- Contract ask: waiver of the standard on-site travel clause and acceptance of remote-only remote onboarding — Legal will want to review.

I recommend we escalate with: summary of commercial impact, proposed approval box ($35k credit + premium support concession), and a clear fall-back (we revert to standard PS pricing if scope exceeds 180 hours). Rishi / Neha — can you prepare the brief for Exec review? I’ll draft the one-page memo.

Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales Ops

Marissa / Lukas — attaching the one-page Exec brief and the cost delta worksheet (attached). Key points pulled out for the leadership note:

1) Strategic rationale: MediSync is a potential reference in the mid-market EMR segment; successful POC could unlock channel introductions into three customers.
2) Financials: Estimated PS cost = $70,000 (120 eng @ $400/hr blended + 40 QA/PM @ $200/hr blended). Requested credit $35,000 = 50% of PS cost. Gross margin impact on initial invoice ~ -$22k.
3) Risk controls: 180-hour approval cap. Any increase beyond 180 triggers re-approval by Sales VP. Remote-only onboarding documented in SOW, travel waived for POC.
4) Replacement terms: Standard MSA applies; we will add a 30-day performance review clause for the POC.

Recommendation: Approve the $35k PS credit and temporary Premium Support concession for the POC under these controls. I’ve also included the suggested Exec approval language for quick sign-off.

Attachments: Integration_Spec_DRAFT.docx, Pricing_breakdown_MediSync.xlsx

-- Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Manager, Deal Desk
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Approved: $35k PS credit + POC Premium Support concession (conditions)

Team — I reviewed the brief and Finance/Legal have signed off on the recommended concession with the following conditions: 

1) Approval granted: one-time $35,000 professional services credit to be applied to first invoice for DEAL-2026-1597.
2) POC Premium Support concession: flat fee of $4,000/mo for the POC term (max 3 months). After POC, Premium Support revert to standard pricing unless Customer converts to production contract.
3) Scope/time controls: Approval covers up to 180 hours of PS/engineering. Any additional hours must be re-submitted to Sales VP for approval. Overages billed at standard PS rates per Pricing_breakdown_MediSync.xlsx.
4) Legal: SOW must include remote-only onboarding clause, 30-day POC performance review, and a signed acknowledgement from MediSync that integration environment access will be provided within 10 business days of SOW signature.

Please prepare final SOW and redline MSA (if any). Once external signatures are in place, Finance will apply the credit to the first invoice and Customer Success will schedule kickoff.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Deal Desk & Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
